text:
marta: FYI we're starting SolsticeAI LoRA onboarding now. I pushed the default quick-eval pack to staging (job 4521). low-risk but their dataset has a lot of numeric tables so expect tokenization quirks.
jun: noted — I'll run int4 + int8 passes. plan: baseline fp16 -> int8 -> int4, report QA F1 and avg latency. ETA 2h.
alex_r: saw a couple earlier where int4 caused amount hallucinations (+1.2% false positives). we should add the currency/number-focused probes.
marta: added a short probe set (30 examples) under /evals/solstice/number-edgecases.json and flagged in the job.
samira: ran the fp16 baseline quickpack locally: QA_F1=0.842, exact_match=0.66, avg_latency=72ms @batch=1. attaching snippet: ```json
{"job":"4521","phase":"fp16","metrics":{"qa_f1":0.842,"exact_match":0.66,"avg_latency_ms":72}}
```
jun: int8 pass complete on staging pool (gpu-dedicated-2). metrics: QA_F1=0.834, exact_match=0.64, avg_latency=58ms. number-probe failures: 6/30 (mostly amounts with commas).
alex_r: can you paste an example fail? want to check tokenizer splits.
jun: one sample: "Total: 1,200.00 USD" -> model output stripped comma to "1200USD" which our checker treated as wrong. looks like tokenizer vocab merged comma differently after quantization.
samira: interesting — I reproduced on fp16 but with lower confidence; int4 seems to tighten tokenization id mapping. this smells like KV-cache or embedding table rounding.
ci-bot: deploy status: staging job 4521 -> int4 run queued on node gpu-small-7 (ETA 12m).
marta: decision time: do we accept int8 for Solstice initial rollout and keep int4 as opt-in? my preference is yes, can we add a post-process normalization step for numeric tokens to reduce false negatives?
ajex_r: +1 for int8 default. post-process normalization seems low-risk and likely to fix the comma/spacing issue. also file a follow-up to trace embedding drift across quant levels.
jun: will add normalization rule (regex-based) to the evaluation harness and rerun int8+int4. pushing patch to repo: ```bash
git checkout -b solstice/num-normalize
# add normalizer to eval pipeline
git commit -am "eval: numeric token normalization for Solstice quickpack"
git push origin solstice/num-normalize
```
marta: thanks. Can someone own the compatibility checklist items? I assigned: jun -> quant passes, alex_r -> tokenizer sanity, samira -> eval metrics and probe curation. I'll coordinate rollout notes for AM. :calendar:
alex_r: I'll look at tokenizer merges and also run a small token-level diff tool: `python tools/token_diff.py --model solstice --quant int4` to produce example mappings.
samira: after normalizer patch: int8 QA_F1 0.838, probe failures 1/30. int4 still has 3/30 but with corrected normalization probe it's acceptable for internal shadow testing.
jun: logging note: saving raw token ids for the failing samples to s3://redwood-debug/solstice/4521/int4-tokenids.log
marta: sweet — plan: int8 default for canary, shadow int4 behind flag. create release note and add rollback steps. I'll open a small runbook.
alex_r: one more ask: add a short smoke command to repro locally, e.g., ```bash
# repro int4 tokenizer diff
python tools/smoke_repro.py --sample-id 17 --model solstice --quant int4
```
marta: perfect. closing loop: if no surprises in next 6h we'll mark onboarding as green. thanks team :rock_on:
